title: OpenAI's First AI Hardware Revealed: Doughnut Shape, Ice Cube Size, Price $300–400, Expected to Launch in 2027

content_html:
Mark Gurman released today's Power On newsletter, revealing more details about OpenAI's first self-developed AI hardware. The product is about the size of a hockey puck (diameter approximately 7.62 cm, volume about 115.8 cubic cm), with a "donut" shape, and is estimated to be priced between $300 and $400 (approximately 2,029 to 2,705 Chinese yuan). It is expected to be released in 2027.

This device is essentially a "smart speaker without a screen," designed for home use, allowing users to carry it around the house with one hand. The product was developed in collaboration between OpenAI and Jony Ive, former Apple designer.

In terms of hardware, Gurman revealed that the device features moving parts, some of which can move automatically to indicate that the device is responding or interacting with the user. In addition, it will also include lighting, a camera system, and other sensors.

In terms of interaction, the device operates similarly to the voice mode of ChatGPT on mobile devices, but will use a more advanced model to support interactions closer to human conversation. This means that OpenAI is extending its experience in conversational AI from the software layer to a hardware platform.

This is OpenAI's first self-developed AI hardware. Previously, the company had launched an AI programming keyboard in collaboration, but this is a truly self-developed hardware product. Gurman's revelations outline a picture of an AI device positioned as a family companion, emphasizing natural voice interaction, and featuring a compact and portable form factor. In an increasingly crowded AI hardware market, OpenAI's decision to collaborate with Jony Ive clearly aims to establish a differentiated barrier in industrial design and user experience.

content_html_zh:
Mark Gurman 今天发布了 Power On 时事通讯，透露了有关 OpenAI 首款自主研发的 AI 硬件的更多细节。 该产品尺寸约为冰球大小（直径约7.62厘米，体积约115.8立方厘米），呈“甜甜圈”形状，预计售价在300至400美元（约合人民币2,029至2,705元）之间。 预计将于 2027 年发布。

该设备本质上是一款“没有屏幕的智能扬声器”，专为家庭使用而设计，允许用户用一只手携带它在家里到处走动。 该产品由 OpenAI 和前苹果设计师 Jony Ive 合作开发。

在硬件方面，古尔曼透露，该设备具有可移动部件，其中一些部件可以自动移动，以表明设备正在响应或与用户交互。 此外，它还将包括照明、摄像系统和其他传感器。

在交互方面，该设备的操作方式类似于移动设备上ChatGPT的语音模式，但将使用更先进的模型来支持更接近人类对话的交互。 这意味着 OpenAI 正在将其在对话式 AI 方面的经验从软件层扩展到硬件平台。

这是OpenAI首款自主研发的AI硬件。 此前，该公司曾合作推出过AI编程键盘，但这是一款真正自主研发的硬件产品。 古尔曼的爆料勾勒出一幅人工智能设备的图景，该设备定位为家庭伴侣，强调自然的语音交互，并具有紧凑便携的外形。 在日益拥挤的AI硬件市场中，OpenAI决定与Jony Ive合作，显然是为了在工业设计和用户体验方面建立差异化的壁垒。
